Azúcar's keeping a secret 🤫💋 We're finally unveiling OUR OWN burlesque troop — Sappholicious — and mama, it's about to get sultry. Hosted by Katana Rexia, this ain't your average show: think seductive choreo, straight-up pool table tricks (yes, you read that right), and comedy sharp enough to leave your jaw on the actual floor. Who's performing? Ni idea todavía — you gotta pull up to find out. All-inclusive cast, unrefined and bold energy, feathers flying and heels clicking on that pool table like it's nothing. Esta noche Azúcar se transforma en cabaret, and once Katana Rexia steps on stage there's no looking away. Tickets move fast for a debut like this, so don't be the one asking what happened.

📅 Saturday, August 22 | Doors 9PM, Show 10:30PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $15-$35

Dim lights, red velvet energy, and heels clicking against a pool table like it's the most natural thing in the world 🎱💃 That's the vibe Katana Rexia is bringing to Azúcar with Sappholicious — our brand new burlesque troop making its debut. Picture slow reveals, sultry stares, corsets and confidence, punchlines landing right between the shimmies. It's unrefined. It's seductive. It's bold, exactly like the flyer promises. The room's gonna smell like perfume and anticipation, la música baja pero la tensión sube, and every set builds until you can't help but gasp out loud. Comedy cuts through just enough so you're laughing one second and fanning yourself the next. Esto no se repite igual dos veces — el debut es único.

Come exactly as you are, porque tonight's stage belongs to everybody 💗🎭 Sappholicious is Azúcar's very own burlesque troop, hosted by Katana Rexia, and it's built to be all-inclusive from the cast to the crowd. Sultry, funny, a lil unexpected (pool table tricks, anyone?) — this show's for the ones who show up for community as much as for the spectacle. Bring your people, bring your best cheer, and get ready to hype up performers who are about to leave everybody's jaw on the floor. No pretension, no judgment, just a room full of us celebrating art, bodies, and a little bit of chaos together. Azúcar's stage, tu gente, una sola energía — esa es la fórmula.
